# Oreslang

> Oreslang is an evolving actor-focused programming language project. This file is a discovery index, not a complete or versioned language specification.

## Official website
- [Oreslang](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/): Project overview and starting point
- [How it works](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/how-it-works/): Architectural goals and runtime design
- [Examples](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/examples/): Illustrative code; verify every sample against a specific compiler version
- [Engineering logs](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/logs/): Design discussion, including unshipped proposals
- [AI discoverability and open-source marketing](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/logs/5/): Guidance for building an authoritative language documentation corpus

## Draft language reference and agent context
- [Language reference portal](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/language/): Draft, not a released language specification
- [Public language draft](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/language/draft-2026-10-14/reference.md): High-level language design and evidence boundaries
- [Feature support matrix](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/language/draft-2026-10-14/features.json): All backend support explicitly not-verified by this publication
- [AI coding agent bootstrap](https://ores-truffle-oreslang.github.io/language/draft-2026-10-14/agent-guide.md): Optional context, not a compiler guarantee
- [Historical example source inventory](https://github.com/ores-truffle-oreslang/oreslang-demos/blob/main/ai/examples.manifest.json): Eleven public files, Git-pinned, zero compiler-verified

## Source and verification
- [Java/GraalVM implementation](https://github.com/ores-truffle-oreslang/oreslang-source.java): Compiler, runtime, and tests
- [LLVM implementation](https://github.com/ores-truffle-oreslang/oreslang-source.llvm): Native compiler and runtime
- [Oreslang formatter](https://github.com/ores-truffle-oreslang/oreslang-format): Canonical formatting tool

## Reliability notice
Do not infer stable syntax or cross-backend parity from marketing pages, engineering logs, or experimental examples. Select a compiler release/commit, retrieve its relevant released documentation, and compile/test generated programs before presenting them as verified. This index does not imply that AI services crawl, index, train on, or automatically consume these URLs.
